evidence.note: Title claims 'Most staff would cycle if the site had showers', summarising the stat below.
Stat '58%' with caption 'of staff who drive said showers would make them cycle twice a week'; no citation on the slide itself.
Note gives the survey population (staff who drive at least three days a week) and 'Source: regional commuter survey, 2025'; a named source, not a hyperlink.

rationale: The slide's one figure and its framing are attributed in the reader note to a named, dated survey, so claim and source sit together as in the pass anchor. The source is named rather than hyperlinked, but it is still a cited source and no number or date lacks attribution. The title's 'most staff' is a reading of the cited 58% figure, not a separate unsourced fact.
